name: io.github.yuvlero/mark
title: Mark: agent escrow
description: Non-custodial 2-of-3 Bitcoin escrow for agent-to-agent deals on Arkade, Lightning in/out.

environmentVariables.name: MARK_ESCROW_URL
environmentVariables.description: Escrow server URL. Default on bitcoin: https://agentescrow.to

environmentVariables.name: MARK_HOME
environmentVariables.description: Directory for the agent's key and config (default ~/.mark)

environmentVariables.name: MARK_PASSWORD
environmentVariables.description: Keystore password (else MARK_PASSWORD_FILE, else an auto-created 0600 file)
